targets.finding: Previous ad-hoc tariff conflict resolved. Current 2026 first-party registered L-Strom.drive regular tariff is 0.54 EUR/kWh AC and 0.64 EUR/kWh DC; this is not anonymous ad-hoc. The operator FAQ explicitly separates ad-hoc charging via the second non-Hubject QR code and public adhoc frontend. A dated 2025-11-06 report quoting Stadtwerke Leipzig states the ad-hoc tariff effective 2026-01-01 is 0.65 EUR/kWh AC and 0.75 EUR/kWh DC. Therefore 0.54/0.64 must not be ingested as ad-hoc.
targets.next: Enumerate post-2024 Leipzig EVSE coverage and verify whether the ad-hoc frontend exposes any station-specific exceptions/fee components before promoting CPO complete.

targets.finding: Current official AUEW ad-hoc matrix remains valid from 2026-04-13: AC zones I/II 0.51 EUR/kWh + 1 EUR start; DC <=50 kW 0.57 EUR/kWh no start fee; DC >50 kW 0.66 EUR/kWh no start fee. Idle-fee rules differ by class/zone. Do not infer EVSE class solely from neighbouring station or operator identity.

coherence.importantCorrection: Leipzig 0.54/0.64 is registered regular tariff, not anonymous ad-hoc; retain 0.65/0.75 as evidenced ad-hoc pending coverage/fee exhaustiveness.
